summary_statement: P1C could not be completed. No materially stronger embedding model on the available host can complete governed snapshot generation. The experiment terminates at Branch D: no practical model candidate is available in the current environment.
hypothesis: A materially stronger governed embedding model may create enough relevance separation for semantic or hybrid ranking to pass the existing frozen gate.
reason_not_tested: No candidate model could complete governed snapshot generation on the LM Studio host. Models crash under sustained load with segfault exit codes; only the P1B control (qwen3-embedding-0.6b) sustains the workload.

candidate.reason: crashes during 336-item embed despite bounded retry

excluded.exclusion_reason: 0/3 stable on real benchmark text; crash under sustained load

governed_path_attempted.embed_336_items_authorized: FAILED — model crashes on real benchmark text after a few items

re_evaluation_conditions: the host's LM Studio stability is repaired (models stop crashing under sustained load)
a different governed embedding endpoint is configured (real OpenAI key with text-embedding-3-large, stable Ollama serving bge-m3, hosted Voyage/Cohere, etc.)
the operator loads a specific stronger model and confirms it sustains the full 336-item embed workload before P1C is reopened

generate_embedding_snapshot.py.P1C_SNAPSHOT_TAG_env: configurable snapshot output dir under docs/p1c_snapshots/<tag>/
generate_embedding_snapshot.py._embed_one_with_retry: bounded (8) single-text retry with exponential backoff for transient provider crashes; authority errors still abort

tooling_added.note: These are generation-tooling robustness improvements, not policy or gate changes. They were necessary to even attempt P1C on the unstable host.

recommended_next_move: Keep P1 paused; redirect engineering to the independent frontend track (TS baseline, 101 errors). Do not begin P2 or build a reranker. The ranking roadmap is blocked on host/provider availability, not engineering effort.
